data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Adǝga faidata kǝla serverbe buro salakye kǝlanzǝyin. Synix dǝ shima komputa adǝn cidajin, adǝye komputa dǝga kǝlanzǝna loktu amso dǝ zaumaro faidatǝ. Kǝrmai kǝlanzǝye kǝla kalkal kǝlanzǝbe kǝlanzǝ nankaro.
1. Synix dayin kuru SteamCMD dependence check dǝga cidiya. 2. Shi Add Server lan, daji server bǝlin sǝkǝna. Shi fayil serverbedǝ zaumaro mbeji, sandiya Import Existing Server dǝga fǝlejin. 3. Suro Generalben, suronzǝ serverbe suye faidatǝ kuru game dǝga fǝlejin. Suro lamba, game version, au loaderdǝ sandima awowa adǝbe fǝlejin. 4. Kǝnǝm kǝlanzǝbe dǝga kǝnǝngǝna, kǝnǝm kǝlanzǝbe dǝga kǝlanzǝnyi. Suro lamarra setupbedǝga faidatǝga gozǝna kuru bayan tǝdǝna dǝga faidatǝga faidatǝga sǝkkǝna. 5. Save Server dǝga zahir. Adǝga shiga dashboard lan kara; shi game dǝ kǝla kǝlanzǝna dǝga gulǝnyi. 6. Shi shiga adǝga kuru start dǝga ciko. Kǝla shi download-a buro salak-a badiyaram-a sǝdǝna-a, awoa Synix-a fǝlezǝnadǝga sadin. 7. Kǝla gǝnatǝbe sambisoro faidatǝ, alamanna kǝrmai, account login-in, au saptǝbe suro game server managerben. 8. Kǝrmai kǝla PC ye dǝn au awo gade kǝlanzǝbe kǝlanzǝyen. Loktu adǝga cidazǝna dǝn, kǝla sandiye kǝla kǝlanzǝ mod-a au faltǝ kura-kura-a sodǝn, sandima backup-a sǝdǝna.
Kǝla Nǝm Dǝa Sǝkǝna Yedǝn Kǝla kǝrmaiye server dǝga fǝlejin kuru kǝlanzǝ Activity & Diagnostics. Kǝla shi kǝrmǝna dǝga wuzǝna ma au kǝlanzǝn start ro waljin. Minecraft au Satisfactoryben, lamarra game guidesbedǝ bayanzǝna kǝla awowa gade-gadewo.
Kǝla am do notǝramnzǝ lan kǝnǝngatǝnadǝ kǝndaramnzǝbe kǝlanzǝben. Kǝrmai dǝye server dǝ kǝla loktǝ lan cidajin.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Kǝla dashboardbedǝ surodǝn sunzǝa kuru fasal installationbedǝga faidatǝ. Synix surodǝ surodǝ surodǝ a Windows- shi kǝratǝbe kǝla fayil-a start settings-a dǝga gozǝna. Adǝye loktuwa faidatǝga faidatǝgǝnyi; shi mashin virtualbe au kǝmbu shimadǝbe ba ro waljin.
Nasha Kǝla Kǝntawu Yedǝn • C:\Synix ‡ main Synix data workspace. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? share game downloader. • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> ‡ normal server installations. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ‡ normal backup root. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? Application logs a crash reports.
Fayila MSI Applicationbedǝ zaumaro suro %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Kǝrmai gade-gadea kuru awowa Windows-a kǝnǝngatǝben sandiye account Windows-an.
Nasha Kǝrmai Yedǝn Faidata Install & Launch dǝga faidatǝ loktu faidatǝ foldǝr serverbedǝ. Suro kǝrtǝwa bǝlinben, follodǝ zaumaro ruwozǝna kuru space zaumaro game-a update-a mbeji. Profil indiye faidatǝ lamarra falro waljiya.
Foldǝ Server Open dǝ sandima faidatǝ serverdǝ zaumaro fǝlejin. Foldǝ Backup Open dǝ na backup dǝga fǝlezǝna; Suro suronzan su fǝlezǝnadǝn sandiya lamarra gade-gade dǝga suwudǝnyi.
SAVES Yedǝa Nankaro Ngǝwuna Game ye dunyawa AppData, Documents, drive gade, au shiye kǝndodǝga faidatǝyin. Kǝrmai kǝla fǝrǝtǝnzǝ kǝlanzǝbe dǝga bayan sǝdǝna.
Shi faidatǝ faltǝ-a au faidatǝ-a suro Files Explorerbedǝ sandidǝ zaumaro banazǝnyi kǝla lamarra kǝnǝngatǝbedǝ samma tǝdǝna. Shi Synix-ye cida kǝrmai import/transfer dǝga faidatǝ kuru lamarra kǝrmai dǝga fuwutǝyin. Kǝla gadegadeye sandima sandiya naptǝram kǝndodǝga mǝradǝtǝna.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers dǝ shima Official Dedicated Server Manager dǝga faidatǝ, shi Synix dǝ zaumaro bayanna. Loktu buro salakye dǝn, Local/Console dǝ zahirzayin, Continue to server configuration dǝ zahirzayin, server-a dunya settings dǝ zahirzayin, kuru Save & start dǝ zahirzayin. Manager dǝga faidatǝro kǝla setings, worlds, mods, administrators-a kuru console-a. Synix ye lamarra adǝ suro serverbe Instance foldǝben gǝnatǝna. Kǝla Local/Console kǝnǝnga dǝye hakki administratǝbe mǝradǝtǝnyi. cida Windows dǝga sǝkkǝna. Kǝla raayiye dǝ .NET Framework ye. 4.8 au tawadǝ, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 kuru 2017, kǝnǝmma 6 GB nasha system RAM, kuru UDP shiye 27016 kǝkǝltǝnadǝ Windows Firewall dǝ kuru router lan routedǝn Internet players dǝye routedǝn. data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Shi watchdog dǝye awowa serverbe kǝlanzayin kuru raktǝ shiye faidatǝnzǝga tǝdǝna bayan waltǝ asutǝnyi au kaziyi bayantǝyin.
KASHAWA NGASHAYA Shi Synixbe kǝndo Stop- a Restart- a faidatǝ faltǝben faidatǝ. Synixye cidawa adǝa kǝlanzǝgǝbe sǝkǝnzǝga, sonyayi hangal hangal hangalnǝbe kǝlanzǝgǝbe kǝlanzǝnyi.
Fato biskebe gǝnatǝ, Task Manager lan gǝnatǝ, au manager gade men gǝnatǝdǝ waneye tǝmazǝnyi kuru nǝmngaltǝ badijin.
KASHIYA Kǝlanzǝ Dǝa Gǝtǝna Server dǝga Synix dǝ ro waljin, daji game log dǝga gǝnyi. Shi runtime, configuration, port, memory, au modbe waltǝ kǝlanzǝna dǝga fuwutǝyin. Recovery dǝ mod-a kuru game-a-a notǝ-a kǝltǝnatǝgǝ-a kǝkǝltǝnyi.
Kǝla cidabe-a askǝrra kǝlanzaye-a sandidǝ awo gade-gade mbeji. Loktu kǝlanzǝbe kǝla game-a kuru kǝlanzǝbe-adǝn, adǝye loktu kǝlanzǝbe-adǝga faidatin.
Kǝla Kǝrmaiye Synix dǝ lancers-a kuru process-a kǝlanzǝbe server-a so-a sadin. Kǝla cidawu kǝnǝngatǝbe au cidawa kǝnǝngatǝbe dǝga kǝnǝngajin kuru sandima game-a controlled-a mǝradǝzana.
Kǝla kǝrtǝbe dǝn sandiya kasatsǝyin kuru sandiya kǝrtǝbe kǝrtǝbe kǝlanzǝbe kǝrtǝbe kǝrtǝbe kǝrtǝbe kǝrtǝbe kǝrtǝbe kǝrtǝben.

data.value:

START Kǝrmai dǝga kǝlanzǝyin kuru start once dǝga kǝlanzǝyin. Synixdǝ awoa faidatǝga, lamarra, shi ports-a kuru awoa faidatǝga notǝgǝ-a notǝgǝ-a, fayil zaumaro faidatǝgǝ-a, kuru server-a fǝletǝgǝna. Kǝla kǝnǝgǝna dǝga kǝnǝgǝna.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory ye mǝradǝgǝnzǝ buro salakye suro in-game Server Manager yen. Synix ye suronzǝ naptǝ kǝlanze'a badijin, amma shidǝ suronzǝ naptǝ kǝlanze'a banajin ba au zamanzǝ cido.
Kǝrmai Kǝla Gǝrmai Yedǝn 1. Shila Satisfactory be badijin kuru Synix lan baditin. 2. Kǝrmai server dǝye cidanzǝ kǝlanzǝyin. 3. Satisfactory-ye Server Manager-a suro game-a lan fǝlejin kuru server-a add au select-a. 4. Kǝnǝgǝna, sandiye fǝlezǝgǝna sandiye sǝkǝna, kuru sandiye fǝlezǝgǝna ro waljin. 5. Sesi dǝga faidatǝro wallono au loading sǝdin.
Synix dǝ awowa lanza/configuration dǝga faidatǝ, suronzan port lanza-a MaxPlayers-a. Fasal faidatabe suro FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.ben mbeji
SYNIX Kǝrmai 1. Serverdǝ -NewConsole. Check dǝga faidatǝ au karewa gǝnatǝga faidatǝyin; shiye dalil adǝga kǝltǝna, Synix lan botin. 2. Synix-a kuru server-a kǝnǝngatǝro faidatǝ samma Windows-a. 3. Server adǝga kǝlanzǝna kuru Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API dǝga kǝlanzǝna. 4. Kǝla kǝlanzǝ kǝlanzǝro kǝlanzǝyin kuru ngaltin.
Synix dǝ server.GenerateAPIToken wono, shiye awoa samno waltǝ kalzayinma, shiye local API dǝga kasatsǝna, kuru shiye token dǝga kasatsǝna kǝla account Windows lan. Token dǝye manazǝgǝro bayanna sǝkkǝnyi, nǝm kǝlanzǝnyi.
Hawarra kǝnasartǝbe Tokendǝ tawatkata kuru tawadǝro gǝnazǝna kuru Overview fǝlezǝna. Nyiye kalkal consolebe-a au tokendǝga muskon gǝnatǝro sǝkǝnyi.
Suro kǝrmai dǝga, Synixbe kǝltǝnzǝna kuru shiye waltǝ kǝlanzǝro tǝdinba. Kǝrmai kǝnǝgǝna dǝga kǝlanzǝna.
Adǝga suronzǝdǝ server tǝdǝna kǝla komputa adǝben; shiye router bǝlinro mǝradǝtǝnyi Synix. Kǝrmai start, stop, kuru restart dǝ shima kǝla alama APIbe kǝlanzǝna.

data.value:
Suro mods au connect settingsbe sadinbedǝn, Minecraft edition dǝga zawarzayin. Java-a Bedrock-a sandima serverbe sammason faidatǝ; Bedrock shima loader Javabe gǝnyi.
Kǝrmai Kǝrmai Kǝrmai 1. Shiye shiga Minecraft gultin kuru shiye Java au Bedrock dǝga fǝlejin. 2. Zauro Javabe, versiya Minecraftbe, loaderbe, kuru versiya loaderbe sambisoro sadin. 3. JAVA A BEDROCK Javabe sandima Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, kuru Purpur sandima gargammadǝ mbeji. Fasal dǝga faidatǝ-a gǝratǝ-a; Paper-a Purpur-a plugins-a faidatǝ, loktu Fabric-a, Forge-a, NeoForge-a faidatǝ mod-a sadin. Synix dǝ loktu runtime kǝlanzǝbe sǝdǝna.
Bedrock dǝ zaumaro Bedrock Dedicated Server paktǝ faidatǝ kuru zaumaro Java faidatǝnyi.
Kǝrmai Yedǝn Gǝnyi Loader dǝga awo kǝla mod ye dǝga faidatǝ. Minecraft version, loader, dependencies, a kuru client-side requirements a kǝltǝna.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, kuru plugin-server packages dǝ zaumaro faltǝnyi. Mods-a au plugins-a faidatǝga suwudǝnadǝ shima loader-a au server framework-a sadinba. Browse Catalog dǝ shima modpack au dependence installationbe kǝlanzǝnyi.
Kǝrmai Kǝla Configure dǝ server.properties-a kuru editǝ kǝla settings-a so. Java dǝ futu Spectatorben faidatǝ. Kǝrmai-a kǝrmai-a kǝrmai-a dǝ shima futu Minecraft ye tǝmanzǝna.
Suro Server Optionsben, Minecraft Control Center lan fǝlejin. Sha Settings-dǝ fayil shimadǝn faidatǝ serverbedǝga bayantǝyin. Edit File dǝ text editing dǝga suwudǝna; Structured Editor dǝ shima format-aware editor dǝga faidatǝ. Sandi samma faltǝ gǝnatǝ loktu server dǝga kǝrtǝyin. Kǝrma server.properties sandima port, player limit, world, seed, mode, kuru command-channel settings dǝ shima shiga shiga Synixbe cidiya. Suro adǝbe kǝlanzǝna dǝye/MOTD dǝ sandiya kǝlanzǝye kǝlanzǝyin. Shi modbe notǝdǝ kǝlanzǝna dǝ sandiye fayilzǝro gǝnyi.
Synixdǝ settings adǝgaima waltǝ karzayin loktu shiga faltǝnyi au badiyatǝnyi, kuru loktu Refresh dǝga faidatǝyin loktu kǝlanza. Shi kǝrmai kǝnǝngabe dǝ zaumaro walzǝna au sandiya shiga gade-a kǝltǝna, hangal gǝnatǝye faidatǝyin kuru serverdǝga tǝdin. Kǝrtǝye fayildǝ faltǝgǝnyi sǝta fǝlejinna; Kǝlanzǝ kǝlanzǝbe kǝlanzǝyin.
Kǝrmai Kǝrmai Kǝrmai Kǝre Kǝrmai serverbe dǝga cidanzǝ kǝlanzǝyin loktu version au loaders faltǝdǝn. Shi runtime bǝlin dǝga setup lan, sandiye waltǝga gǝnatǝro wallono, daji Apply Runtime suro Minecraft Control Center lan. Synix dǝ runtime kǝlanzǝbe sambisoro kǝlanzǝyin, server.properties-a dunya follodǝa kǝlzǝyin, kuru fayil runtime-a faltǝgǝdǝa notǝyin. Kǝrmai server dǝ kǝlanzǝnyi. Start dǝ kǝrtǝyin loktu runtime kasattǝ-a kuru profile zahirro waljin.
Shi fayil roolback ye dǝ shima faltǝ kǝla dunyabe dǝga bayanzǝdǝn bayanzǝdǝna. Dunyayi zaumaro futunzǝdǝ Minecraft kura au mod gade gadeye zaumaro runtime kureye ro waljinba. Kǝrmai kǝla kǝla kǝlanzǝbe dǝga suwudǝna.
Futu fayilan faltǝro faltǝdǝga sǝdǝna. Kǝla duno ngǝwusoye zaumaro faidatǝro kǝratǝyin.
Kammabo so dǝ raksǝ kǝltǝyin ba Kǝla gade-gade, game/loader versions, required mods, and the actual port/protocol of the selected edition. Kǝla kǝrma ro, game log dǝga zaumaro hangal, runtime, memory, au dependence error-a mbeji.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
MODPACK Kǝla Server Yedǝ Kǝlan Gǝratǝna 1. Kǝrmai kǝnǝgǝnzǝbe dǝ zaumaro faltin kuru kǝnǝgǝnzǝga kǝnǝgǝnzǝnyi. Synix lan faidatǝ sha Windowsbe faidatǝ. 2. Kǝrma dǝye Minecraft versiyon, loader-a loader-a kǝlanzǝyin. 3. Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins lan, Import Server Pack dǝga fǝlejin. Modrinth .mrpack au ZIP serverbe sambisoro kǝla mods/plugins a kuru fayila konfigurationbe mbeji. 4. Optional server mods dǝ letǝgǝnyi sai nǝm Include optional server mods dǝ kartǝgǝnyi. Modrinth do kǝmoduwu bas-a kuru kǝmoduwuwa do kǝmoduwu bas-a gǝnyi faidatin. 5. Kǝrmai scanbe, metadata kǝlanzǝnabe, surodǝga kuru fayila kada zauro faidatǝ, faltǝgǝnyi, au suwudǝnyi. Kǝla fuwutǝ-a faltǝ-a faidatǝ-a mbeji. 6. Kǝrmai kǝlanzǝna lan start karǝgǝna, console dǝga kǝlanzǝna, kuru kǝrtǝgǝ kǝrtǝgǝma dǝga kǝrtǝgǝyin.
Lardǝ am cidaro gǝnatǝgǝna dǝ sandima shiro pack-supplied launch scripts, replace worlds, au overwrite root server.properties sǝdǝnyi. Kǝla kǝlanzǝye nǝm server pack dǝga sǝdǝna maa CurseForge kǝlanzǝye export dǝ suronzan download manifest dǝma mbeji. Private downloads, non-supported hosts, au non-supported loaders so dǝye suronzǝbe fayil serverbe banazǝna mǝradǝzana; Synix dǝ kalkallo kǝmbu sǝdǝnyi.
Modrinth downloads dǝ hash- checked. Metadata JAR be dǝga banazǝnadǝ loader-a, kalkallo kare-a, duplicate IDs-a, kuru dependencies bayantǝna-a kǝla JAR be ladǝn gǝnatin. Metadata donyi notǝnyi dǝ kuru nǝm kura-kura do fafaltǝ mǝradǝna. Kǝlanzǝ kǝlanzǝro gǝnatǝgǝ au nǝmngaltǝnzǝ asutinba ma sǝkkǝ mod dǝ nǝmngaltin au kalkaljin ba. Kǝndodǝga gǝnyiro awowa nǝmngǝlabe gǝnyi sandiya asutin ba.
Kǝla samno botǝnama dǝga faidatǝ awoa JAR-a gǝnatǝgǝnabe sadin, amma sandi fayilan awoa kasattǝgǝnabedǝga kǝltǝlan. JAR-a kuru fayila dunyabe sandima gǝnatǝgǝnyi. Fasal shimadǝn faidatǝ suro fasal bǝlinben tǝbandǝnadǝ shima karewa kureye faltǝyin. Shi preview dǝ sandiya bayanzǝna kǝla adǝye bayantǝna. Shi server-ZIP faidata faidatabe adǝgaima saktǝyin loktu paktǝ adǝn faidata.
DUNYA Yedǝn Kǝrmai Dunyawa faidatǝ dunyawa nozǝnabe daptǝ nankaro. Import World ZIP ye dunya fal matching-edition yedǝ suro folder bǝlindǝro sakkin; Dunya kǝlanzǝye gǝrtǝnyi au kate Java-a Bedrock-a faltǝnyi. Kǝla dinadǝye gǝnatǝ-a kǝndaram dinaye-a faltǝ nankaro Synix's kǝndaram dinaye dǝga falzǝyin. Badiyaram fuwunna dǝye dunya suwandǝna dǝga kǝlzǝyin. Kǝska dǝ faltǝdǝ kǝla dunya bǝlinbero faidatin, na dǝwo kǝlanzǝma dǝro gǝnyi.
Kǝrmai Kǝla Shi Recovery ye list fayilbedǝga faltǝwo cidabe adǝben suwudǝna. Undo ye fayilwa ngaltǝbe burobedǝn faidatǝ au fayilwa faltǝben faidatǝga suwudin. Ngaltǝgǝna dǝ dunya importbedǝn sǝkǝna dǝga dǝga kǝlanzǝna. Kǝla fayilawa dǝga ngawoye, Synix dǝga suronzan ruwozǝna; Kǝla gǝnatǝbe kuru faidatǝ karewa fulutǝbe faidatǝben, loktu mǝradǝtǝben.
Kǝla fuwutǝbe dǝga cidiya badiyatǝ sai fuwutǝbe dǝga wuratǝ kuru shiga cidiyabe dǝga faidatǝben sadin. Kǝrtǝwa kurebe kǝla runtime profile dǝga notǝnyi sandidǝye faidatǝ kǝla runtime recoverybero. Backupsdǝ sandima server-folder-a gargaltǝnadǝga sambisoro wallono, kǝrmai faltǝbe kǝlanzaben.
Ngawo full-backup restore lan, karewa kaziyibe faltǝbedǝ sandiya karewa cidanzǝro tǝdin. Sandiye zaumaro bayantǝyin amma sandiya raktǝ fayilwa bǝrnibe dǝga suwudinba. Kǝla gǝnatǝbe au kǝratǝbe bayanzǝna ngawo bǝrnibedǝye awoa gargǝmtǝro wallono.
Nashawu Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝlan Diagnostics dǝye log bǝlin-a kwasa kazǝmube-a kǝla kaziyiya Java be-a, memory be-a, dependency be-a, port be-a, world be-a, kuru tick-time be-a ro kǝrajin. Kǝla fasal laa asutǝnyi dǝ hujja donyi server dǝ kalkal gǝnyi ma wo. Performance dǝ resource monitor-a sutuluyin; Ngaltǝwu CPU-a RAM-a dǝ sandima kalkal gǝnyi kǝla nzǝrtaliu tick game ye dǝn.
Schedules dǝ Synix's dǝga waltǝ badijin-a kuru nzǝli nzǝliwobe-a sutuluyin. Kǝnda-a, loktu-a, bikke makkarbe-a, backup-a, kuru awowa bǝlinbe-a gozǝyin, daji kulashin-a sutuluyin. Na cidabe dǝ kalkallo kalkalma kǝn indimi gǝnyi au kalkalnǝmma faltin ba.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
setup mǝradǝtǝna dǝ:
1. Synix dǝ shima Space Engineers Dedicated Server Manager dǝga kǝlanzǝyin kuru shi dǝ zauro waljin.
2. "Local/Console" fǝlejin, "Continue to server configuration" fǝlejin, server-a dunya settings-a fǝlejin, daji "Save & start" fǝlejin.
3. Manager dǝga faidatǝro kǝla setings, worlds, mods, administrators-a live console-a. Bayanna serverbedǝ suro fasal Synix serverbe Instanceben gǝnatǝna.
4. Kǝla Local/Console kǝnǝnga dǝye hakki administratǝbe mǝradǝtǝnyi. Windows service mode ye dǝ ro waljin.
5. Awo mǝradǝtǝna: .NET Framework 4.8 au bǝlindǝ, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 kuru 2017, gananzǝma 6 GB of system RAM, kuru UDP port 27016 shiga zardǝ Windows Firewall lan kollatǝ kuru Internet players ro letǝyin.
6. Huwuma Kǝreye: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Lardǝ kǝlanzǝna dǝga faidatǝ.
Cidawu SYNIX Kǝla & Diagnosticsbe lamar cidabe-a lamar faidatǝ-a lamar faidatǝ-a fǝlezayin. Kǝla shimadǝn kǝlanzǝna sandiye shiga bayantǝgǝna dǝga fǝlejin. shiye sandiye kulasha kǝrtǝbe sammason suwudǝnyi.
application logs (Logwa kulashibe) Synix text logs a fatal-crash report so dǝ alamanna: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Kǝla kalkal hangalbedǝ fayil ngalwotǝgǝna. Kǝla adǝa kuru loktu loktu kǝlanzǝbe dǝga faidatǝro.
Kǝla nzunduye zaumaro faidatǝro raksajin kuru sandiya sandima lamar shimadǝn fǝlejinba. Kǝla lamarra kǝlanzǝbe dǝye fǝlezǝnadǝ shima hujja kǝlanzǝbe kǝlanzǝben.
GAME LOGS Fasal game log dǝga faidatǝ kǝla world-loading, configuring, mod, kuru game-runtime errorben. Loktu dǝ kǝla game ye dǝga kǝlanzǝyin kuru raktǝ kǝla root installation ye dǝn.
Kǝla Kǝlanzǝna Kǝrmai-a loktu-a, daji bayanna kǝla buro salakye kǝlanzǝna dǝga gǝnyi. Layi shutdownbe dǝga kǝla kǝlanzǝna dǝga kǝlanzǝna dǝga kǝlanzǝna.
Kǝrmai kǝlanzǝna ro, sandi sandiya, tokeniya, webhooks, adirese soye, kuru lamar kǝlanzǝbe. Console/log Satisfactorybe dǝn alamaram administratǝbe mbeji. Kǝrmai kǝrmai dǝye kǝlanzǝn zawalzǝ nankaro.

TEST LOCALLY 1. Shi game dǝga kǝla gǝnyi. 2. Shiye shi kǝrtǝ gǝnatǝ-a kuru serverbe Kǝrtǝ-a bayantǝ-a. 3. Host PC lan kǝltǝ, daji LAN na gade lan. 4. Loktu lan access dǝga faidata, game log a kuru Windows firewall access a kǝla server runtable dǝga.
Kǝla Internet Players dǝye letǝyin 1. Shi host ye lan address gultin, ngǝwusoro router DHCP reservation. 2. Shiye awoa mǝradǝtǝna dǝga fǝlejin kuru shiye TCP/UDP kǝrmai kǝla game shimadǝben. 3. Sandi endpoints dǝga lan host ye lan ro forward karǝgǝna. 4. Kǝla game traffic ye kǝla Windows Firewall ye kǝla network profiles ye faidataben. 5. Kǝrmai kǝla Internetbe kǝlanzǝna lan.
DMZ routerdǝ banazǝnyi, firewalldǝ banazǝnyi, au portwa amaribe samma fǝlezǝnyi. Karǝgǝ routerbe dǝ kǝlanzǝro gǝne.

data.value:
SteamCMD fayil-a server-a kǝratǝ-a tǝdǝna-a faidatǝ-a. Steam game dǝn. Synix ye kasattǝbe kǝlanzǝga sambisoro tǝdin; Kǝla sha serverbedǝ sandilan faidatǝ zaumaro SteamCMD tabbe mǝradǝtǝnyi.

Kǝrmai Kǝrmai Kǝrmai Kǝrmai Sǝrǝnadǝ → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Shiye mode limited dǝga tǝbandǝna dǝga fǝlejin, au full speed dǝga fǝlejin.
Adǝye SteamCMD downloads dǝga waltǝgǝnyi, bandwidth players'a, game's non-Steam downloader'a, au traffic samma PC'a.
sign-in-a failsuwa-a Shi game profile bǝlinye zaumaro faidatǝ account Steam a kuru Steam Guard confirmation a. Synix's sign-in prompt dǝ faidatǝ; Kǝla bayanna kǝla account credentialsbedǝye shiga lamarra au raporowa kǝlanzaben notǝnyi.
Kǝla fayil dǝga faidatǝro, kurta SteamCMDbe kalkalzayin kuru sandima space diskbe-a, folder-a, network-a-a-a-a-a-a-a mǝradǝtǝna-a. Kǝrtǝro fayil so'a faidatǝro waltǝ gǝnatǝyin, adǝye sǝkǝ faltǝ-a faltǝ-a faidatǝ-a.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Empyrion scenarios a kuru server-code mod dǝ gade. Suro Server Options → Mod & Plugin Managerben, Empyrion scenarios au Empyrion server mods dǝga fǝlejin. Server dǝga kǝnǝmzǝna dǝ kuru shi server dǝga kǝnǝmzǝna dǝga kǝnǝmzǝna dǝga faltǝna.
SINSENARIO Kǝlanzǝna 1. Browse Catalog dǝ shima Steam Workshop dǝga fǝlejin. Sǝrayi dǝga tagǝnyi kuru hangal Steam dǝga kǝla gǝnyi. Kǝrmai-a gargam-a cidabe-a sandilan sandiye server-a sadinba. 2. Package Import dǝga, daji Folder dǝga. Sǝkǝ foldǝr shimadǝn zaumaro faidatǝ suro foldǝr Steambe steamapps\workshop\content\383120ben. Sandiye waltǝ zaumaro kǝlanzǝna dǝro waltǝ zaumaro kǝlanzǝna. 3. Sǝkǝ faidatǝ sandima sandiye faidatǝro bayanzǝna. Kǝla lamba sha Workshop ID lan faidatǝnyi. Suro name follodǝbe sambisoro kǝlanzǝro. 4. Kǝla gǝrtǝye-a naptǝye-a naptǝye-a, daji import dǝga bayanzǝna. Synix ye kasatsana ngǝwuso Content\Scenarios lan sammaso faidatǝnyi au dunyabe faltǝnyi. 5. Scenario dǝlan listǝsǝdǝna sandi scenarios dǝro. Sǝkǝ fal gozǝna kuru suronzan cidanzǝ kǝlanzǝ. Kǝla futu gade-gade-lan faltǝ-a, suronzǝ-a faidatǝbe-a, suronzǝ-a notǝ-a. Synix dǝ shima adǝga suwudǝna kuru shiye kǝnǝgǝnzǝ dǝ gǝnyi. 6. Sǝkǝnadǝga faidatǝ, kǝrtǝ start, kuru shi log-a kǝrtǝ kǝltǝ-a. Scenario'a gade-gade'a ngaltǝgǝ au mǝradǝtǝna kǝla awoa ruotǝgǝnaben.
Scenario dǝ shima GameConfig.CustomScenario; Surnǝ kǝnǝngǝna dǝ GameConfig.GameName ye. Synix dǝ dedicated.yaml dǝga bayanzǝyin loktu sandi lamar adǝ faltǝdǝn kuru shiga server dǝga cidanzǝyin. Shiye seed, passwords, au settings kada kǝltǝnyi.
MODS Dǝ Server Dǝye Sǝkǝna Shi Empyrion server mods profile a kuru Import Package a faidatǝ mod ZIP kǝltǝbe au mod folder completǝbe. Shi DLL-saye, awowa dǝga fuwutǝyinma, awowa gade-gade-a, kuru _Info.yaml-a loktu tǝdinma. Synix dǝ sandima suro Content\Mods-ye sutuluwuna; game dǝ code dǝ loktu badiyatǝdǝn loadǝna. Kǝla source-code downloads-a kuru standalone installer-a dǝga faidatǝnyi.
Synix mod loader dǝga fǝletǝnyi au mod dǝga fǝletǝyin. Shiye raayiwu kǝrmaibe, suronzan loader, configuration, kuru client setupbe mbeji. Shiye kǝrtǝro kǝrtǝyin dǝga fǝlezǝna kǝla moddǝ shima awowa gamebe au gadegade gadegadebe sadin.
Kǝla Kǝntawu Yedǝn Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝntawu Yedǝn Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝla Kǝlan Steam ye kǝrǝnzǝ Workshop ye sabsǝyin, kǝrǝnzǝ server ye Synix ye sabsǝyin ba. Kǝndodǝro, server dǝga datǝgǝne kuru kazǝmu kǝndodǝga faidatǝne su kambo scenariobe dǝga. Kǝla kǝrmai dǝye awo bǝlin mǝradǝzǝna ma. Fayilawa suwandǝna dǝ rowotǝgǝ ruotǝna; Awo bǝlindǝga gǝnatǝgǝdǝ waltǝ gǝnatǝgǝnyi kuru fayildo suro fasal bǝlinbe dǝga kolzǝnyi.
Futuwa ngǝwuso sandima awoa gade-gadebe kǝlanzǝdǝ gǝnatǝgǝnyi. Shiye faidatǝ (ro waltǝ kasatsǝyin) shiye maana shiye import dǝga kasatsǝyin, ba shiye fayil ngal ngalwotǝgǝna sambisoro kasatsǝyin. Shi Roll Back Import ye samno import dǝga faidatǝ, suronzan gadegade suro fasal adǝben mbeji, kuru fayilan faltǝ gǝnatǝgǝ Synix lan. Scenario-a scenario-a sandima sandiye dunnyawa kǝnǝngatǝyedǝn faidatǝro walzǝna dǝga sǝkkǝna; Kǝla sandiye kasatsǝna dǝga faidatǝro waljin.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Futu kǝrmai → Network & RCON dǝga kǝlanzǝgǝ kǝla endpoints kǝla game zahirdǝro waljin. Fasal gamebe dǝga faidatǝ, shiye listǝ kǝla portbe dǝga faidatǝnyi.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Profil Rustbe sǝkǝ kuru dunya, bayanna, gameplay, askǝrra, kuru hangal gǝnatǝbe burobedǝn badiyaram.
Kǝrmai Kǝla Kǝlan Synix dǝ daraja +server.identity dǝga faidatǝ suro serverbedǝn. Kǝla gadegade-a nǝmgade-a gadegade-a kǝlanza-a gǝnatǝgǝ, adǝgaima sandiye dunnyawa au fasalladǝ-a kǝltǝgǝnyi.
RUST+ Kǝla App Port faidatǝye zaumaro faidatǝro, daji Rust's pairing-a network-a mǝradǝtǝna. Shi endpoint dǝ gameplay player-a kuru RCON administration-a sǝdin.
Portwa kalkallo fasaltǝna dǝga kulashiye gǝnyi kaida server Rust gadebe dǝga koltǝro. Zande RCONye dǝ kǝla kǝlanzǝben gǝrǝmzǝyin kuru sandiya kǝla kǝlanzǝben gǝnatǝgǝnyi amsowa banazǝ nankaro.
VANILLA A OXIDE Vanilla dǝ fayil serverbe kǝlanzǝgǝro faidatǝ. Lardǝ Oxide dǝye bayanzǝna kǝla awoa zaumaro faidatǝnadǝben. Steam fayilan. Kǝrmai shimadǝye plugins kǝlanzǝga zaumaro notǝnyi.
Mod & Plugin Manager's ye banazǝna local workflow lan faidatǝ Oxide/uMod installation tǝwandǝna dǝn. Plugins dǝ kuwayaye-a tuskawa tawatkata-a mǝradǝtǝna.
Synix dǝ loktu oxide runtime dǝga faidatǝ ngawo Rust update au validation dǝyen, loktu shimadǝn zahirzǝna. Faidata Vanilla faylbedǝga waltǝro waljin, karǝngǝ gǝnatǝbe faltǝ-gǝnatǝga faltǝ-gǝnatǝ kuru shi update au validate workflow dǝga fuwutǝyin.
Kawu shimadǝa au gamebe faltǝdǝn, dunyaa, konfiguration-a kuru plugin-a kǝlanzǝna. Shiye game-a Oxide log-a loktu start-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a. shiro framework download gultin dǝga fǝlezǝnyi kǝla shiro pluginbe sammaso raktǝ zaumaro faidatǝna.
